timeline.body: Hi @lkts, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

reply.body: It's still needed to not always start an object with a field name. For nested we need to be in control since we make a distinction between single and multi-children.

timeline.body: These changes here and above are somewhat surprising.. Is the idea that nested objects will be adding their own `start/endObject` tags, so we don't need to do it at the nested object level?

reply.body: Yes, `leafSourceLoader` is responsible for these tags now.

timeline.body: We probably need to port this to 8.15 too.

reply.body: We test both objects and nested with this configuration using our integration tests (that's how i found this).

timeline.body: Good catch @lkts , I left a comment regarding the tests.
